tasks.title: Generate strict operation and capability contracts
tasks.goal: Provide one validated registry/facade request/result/error/event surface for every domain.
steps: First create/update the governing permanent anchors in vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-080-machine-operations-and-observability.xml for this task's contract, with desired-versus-implemented status explicit. Only then add executable types or tests citing those anchors. Final promotion/retirement records evidence later; it is not permission to postpone the source contract.
Extend owned JTD registry/codegen with namespaced operation/model/schema descriptors and typed prepared/input/admission/result/error/event unions.
Validate requests before dispatch and results/errors/events before publication; wrong types, unknown fields and unsupported epochs are explicit refusals.
Register domain handlers through shared application-service composition; discovery reads retained descriptors and never executes a provider or fetches a schema.
positive_cases: One domain operation has identical validated shape through library and transport adapters.
An admitted extension schema is discoverable without native execution.
negative_cases: Wrong optional argument types silently select defaults.
An advertised restrictive schema is not enforced at dispatch.
checks: CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask check-codegen only when the actual diff affects schemas, generators, generated-output registration or a dependent contract. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

CONDITIONAL ORACLE: cargo xtask wire-diff only when the actual diff affects wire/format behavior, its corpus or epoch semantics. Bind a narrower existing oracle if available; the global command needs that concrete impact and no adequate narrower check.

Exact extension-schema producer amendment: after source-first PROP-054/PROP-080 law, B.1 may add an optional typed authored operation-schema declaration to the existing ExtensionDecl/strict wire and carry it through the already retained workspace/registry projection without native load. The 29 current ExtensionDecl literal owners are enumerated as exact paths in this packet; edits outside those names require another explicit perimeter amendment. Arbitrary config, native ABI manifest loading, provider fetch/build and synthetic callable status are forbidden. Retained package/source identity and registered format/epoch validation must precede positive descriptor-only discovery; source-observed catalogue rows remain noncallable. The current capability catalogue must be reconciled against actual CLI/MCP additions before claiming a complete denominator.

Frozen fingerprint test binding: the new optional operation-schema metadata is explicitly excluded from the existing execution-declaration fingerprint under PROP-054, while the authored manifest/source witness changes. state/tests/declaration.rs is at the 600-line ceiling after the mechanical None field, so its focused metadata-exclusion case lives in the exact new state/tests/discovery_schema.rs sibling, registered only through state/tests.rs; do not expand the old file or rewrite the fingerprint epoch.

Selected-world descriptor projection is bounded to the existing retained ExtensionWorldEpoch/registry row and two exact new workspace leaves, because extension_world.rs is 586 lines. It validates the new authored format IDs/epochs with already generated FormatId values and selected provider/content identities without a second manifest read, native library load, provider build or fetch. Distinguish a registered schema under a lock-bound selected manifest from verified physical-content CAS; unverified host/source remains unavailable with a reason. Emit source-observed/noncallable descriptor data, never handler authorization.

tasks.title: Define entity, composite snapshot and source-location views
tasks.goal: Give external clients exact, navigable model identities without pretending all changing domains are one atomic snapshot.
steps: First extend the permanent PROP-080 source anchors for logical/capture/observation/occurrence identity, composite snapshot and paging compatibility, and source-location basis with desired-versus-implemented status. Only then add code and focused tests citing those anchors.
Define separate logical entity, capture/content, observation/snapshot and presentation occurrence references using existing domain IDs where valid.
Describe CompositeSnapshot as compatible source/world/target/operation observations with completeness; bind filters/pages/children/chunks to one projection and refuse mixed versions.
Define opaque resource IDs, trusted URI mapping and raw/projection position basis with encoding/revision, including non-UTF8 resources and unavailable source mappings.
positive_cases: Repeated inclusion shares logical identity but has distinct occurrences.
All pages from one captured query reconstruct the full authorized structure.
negative_cases: Wall-clock time or display line is used as exact snapshot identity.
Projected Markdown positions are presented as original XML locations.

tasks.title: Negotiate the local transport and trusted contexts
tasks.goal: Publish a precise on-demand machine-session framing/handshake contract compatible with existing MCP boundaries.
steps: Implement versioned local framed request/event transport with initialization for API/schema versions, position encoding and streaming/replay/control capabilities.
Register workspace/member/HOME/container contexts only from the trusted owning surface; requests refer to assigned context/target IDs.
Map actual negotiated MCP versions/capabilities into the same domain facade while preserving explicit legacy tools; reject malformed frames, unknown versions and unbound roots.
positive_cases: Two clients negotiate supported versions and independently bind authorized contexts.
One-shot library/CLI usage remains available without starting a server.
negative_cases: Caller body path or workspace manifest self-authorizes a new root.
Initialization reports a fixed unsupported protocol version.
